Web K initConnection: deviceModel = user agent, systemVersion = navigator.platform (lines 55-56)
Webogram initConnection: device_model = navigator.userAgent, system_version = navigator.platform (lines 827-828)
Web A initConnection: deviceModel = navigator.userAgent, systemVersion = platform (lines 116-117)
Web A getPlatform: Win32 -> Windows, MacIntel -> macOS, Linux* -> Linux

notes: share_bp is a share in hundredths of a percent, copied from the StatCounter rows cited above; macos sums the OS X and macOS rows.
Weight of a browser on an OS: round(browser share_bp * OS share_bp / sum of the share_bp of the OSes the browser lists), so each browser keeps its cited share and splits it by desktop OS share.
Windows 10 and Windows 11 report the same Windows NT 10.0 token in every browser here, so one windows entry covers both.
Edge lists Windows and macOS only, as the 1.5.0 web catalog did; Safari ships on macOS only; Chrome OS has no entry.
version is the token the UA carries: the major for the reduced Chromium UAs, major.minor for Firefox and Safari; release is the full build it came from.
